title: Custom Usage-Based Billing System: Stop Giving Away Your Server Resources
body:
Are your largest clients consuming 80% of your resources but paying the exact same subscription as everyone else?

As your software company or B2B platform scales, the traditional tiered flat-rate model becomes a financial drain. Your corporate users devour your bandwidth, computing power, and storage, skyrocketing your infrastructure bills. Meanwhile, you keep billing the exact same amount at the end of the month, destroying your operating profit margins and limiting your capacity for growth.

The trap of standard CRMs and Payment Gateways

Attempting to adapt generic subscription tools to log real-time consumption events always ends in locked databases and phantom or unrecorded charges. Relying on standard integrations for high-transaction models is a ticking time bomb for your cash flow.

Our solution: Data Architecture for Usage-Based Billing

At LANZAESTUDIO, we design and implement a custom system based on Time-Series databases and asynchronous event processing. This engine captures, aggregates, and reconciles millions of user actions without adding latency to your core application, issuing dynamic invoices with accounting-level precision.

  1. Massive Event Ingestion: We deploy specialized database clusters to log every API call, video second, or transferred megabyte without bottlenecks.
  2. Real-Time Aggregation Engine: We group and calculate raw consumption using custom-programmed algorithms, transforming technical data into billable business metrics.
  3. Reconciliation and Immutable Auditing: We guarantee billing integrity with write-only ledgers, allowing transparent financial audits for any B2B dispute.
  4. Transactional Synchronization (Webhooks): We natively connect the resulting calculations with Stripe, Paddle, or your accounting ERP to execute automatic billing at the end of the month.

The Real Impact on your Profitability

  • Total Alignment of Costs and Revenue: Your margins are automatically protected; if your server costs rise due to increased usage, your B2B billing proportionally increases as well.
  • Attraction of New B2B Clients: You lower the barrier to entry by charging only for what they use, facilitating the conversion of companies fleeing rigid subscriptions.
  • Eradication of Revenue Leakage: We ensure that every computing millisecond or processed byte is rigorously accounted for and billed without data loss.
